clue.text: Badger, animal seen by wayside?

clue.text: I drop after rally near end of final, defeated

clue.text: Who might have no score at end of game?

definitions.text: Who might have no score at end of game?

a ration is a fixed allowance given out to workers

clue.text: Struggle with conviction

parts.note: to vie is to struggle or compete

explanation.definitionFit: A view is an opinion or belief firmly held.

clue.text: Vegetable stew: pâté too is ordered

parts.note: taken as written

taken as written

clue.text: Moving component of car — it's always rotating

clue.text: Used old copper to bind article mostly

clue.text: Dieter finally tucked into healthier kind of food

clue.text: Item of clothing, stained, needing regular scrubbing
